name: Kazoku Kankin ~Manamusume Misuzu, Fuki no Sekai to Yuganda Kairaku~
original_name: 家族監禁～愛娘みすず、不帰の世界と歪んだ快楽～
source:
It’s just before evening.
Sayaka, the wife of Yukiteru’s former boss, Shoutarou Okabe, is still being violated by Yukiteru and his companions.

Meanwhile, their daughter, Misuzu, returns home, unaware of what’s happening.
The moment she steps inside, she’s seized by Yukiteru as a new target.
Dragged into the room, Misuzu is confronted with the sight of her mother, Sayaka, being assaulted by strangers.

The sheer shock leaves Misuzu’s mind in chaos.
Before she can process it, she’s pinned down by the men…

[Translated from [url=http://tsumami.kannaduki.jp/soft/006_kazokukankin2/index.html#STORY]the official website[/url]]
